rules.description: Mirror feature must be enabled globally for all mirror endpoints
Mirror sync requires write access to code unit
Repository must be a pull mirror to trigger mirror-sync
Push mirror operations require repo admin access
rules.condition: reqAdmin() middleware applied to push_mirrors group
rules.action: Return 403 if user is not repo admin

rules.description: Push mirror interval must be valid duration and >= MinInterval (or 0)
Remote address must pass URL validation and migration allow/block list
Push mirror remote name is auto-generated with random suffix
rules.action: Generate remote name as 'remote_mirror_' + 10-char random string

rules.description: Remote address is sanitized before storage (credentials stripped)
rules.action: Store sanitized URL (without credentials) in push_mirror.remote_address

rules.description: If git remote registration fails, the DB record is cleaned up
rules.action: Delete the push mirror record from DB, return 500
